messages:
incident_bot: ALERT P0 — hosted-api-us-east: GPU pool "hosted-gpu-pool-1" saturated; request queue > 25000; p95/p99 token latencies spiking. Pager: https://pd.example/INC0001
mike_oncall: I'm on it. grabbing context. Any recent deploys? @kevin_infra @anna_platform
kevin_infra: No infra deploys in last 24h. Cloud shows AMI scale requests failing with 403 QuotaExceeded for GPUs. Logs: `ProvisionerError: quotaExceeded: requested 8, available 0`.
anna_platform: We pushed an optimizer change to routing yesterday but rollout is 5% — shouldn't cause this. Traffic pattern looks like a sudden client spike from partner X. @liz_support can you confirm customer reports?
liz_support: Customer mailpile shows many 504s starting 10:42 UTC. Multiple customers reported degraded API. Posting sample: "generation timed out at 30s". Escalated to AE.
jon_sre: Autopilot autoscaler logs show repeated CreateInstance API errors and then backoff loop. `createInstances() -> 429: RateLimitExceeded` then `Provisioner: failed to bind GPU`.
mike_oncall: Ok, immediate mitigations: 1) enable degraded-mode routing to lowest-cost model variant; 2) throttle non-paid SKUs; 3) manual scale-up if cloud can satisfy. I'll run the runbook.
anna_platform: Degraded route is ready. Patch incoming: `routes.hosted-api.degraded=true` — applying now.
(sre_bot): Deploy pipeline: promoted degraded routing flag to 100% for route hosted-generation - 3s
mike_oncall: Throttling non-paid clients now: `curl -X POST https://ops-api/internal/quotas/throttle -d '{"tier":"free","rate":0.2}'`
kevin_infra: Manual scale attempt -> cloud returned `403: InsufficientProjectQuota: GPU quota exhausted in us-east-1`. Our spare-reserved pool has 4 GPUs but templated to dedicated customers. Can reassign if ops approves.
mike_oncall: Approve reassign. Kevin pls rebind 4 reserved GPUs into hosted pool. We need immediate headroom.
kevin_infra: Doing RBAC/ops swap now. CLI:
``ncloudctl compute resize --pool reserved-gpu-1 --to 0
cloudctl compute attach --pool hosted-gpu-pool-1 --gpus 4
```
mike_oncall: Any risk to dedicated customers? @sales_ops @liz_support
sales_ops: Not ideal but biggest customer on dedicated has low usage now and agreed to emergency reassign earlier this quarter. I'll notify them but do the swap.
liz_support: Notifying impacted enterprise customers and posting status page update: "Investigating increased latencies in hosted-api us-east". ETA message in 10m.
jon_sre: Autoscaler backoff loop fixed temporarily by swap, but we still see provisioner failing for larger scale-ups. Plan B: enable fallback to multi-region routing (us-west) for new requests.
anna_platform: Routing policy updated: prefer us-west if hosted-gpu-pool-1 queue > 20000. Patch applied.
(sre_bot): Routing rule update success. Traffic rebalanced ~18% to us-west within 2m.
mike_oncall: p95 fell from 2.4s to 1.2s, p99 still high at ~8.5s but trending down. Queue dropped from 25k to 9k. Good.
liz_support: Status page update posted. Customers reporting partial recovery but a few still hitting timeouts.
kevin_infra: Follow-up: Cloud quota team confirmed a transient quota enforcement due to internal billing job. They've lifted some GPUs now; we can request additional capacity but lead time ~12-30m.
mike_oncall: Next steps: 1) keep degraded routing + throttle; 2) request additional GPUs from reserved pool + cloud request; 3) investigate root cause for quota enforcement; 4) runbook for autoscaler retry/backoff tuning. Assignments: kevin->cloud request, jon->autoscaler logs, anna->routing checks, liz->customer comms.
jon_sre: Found a noisy client causing most requests: heavy batch from partner X with misconfigured autoretry. Blocking their API key temporarily.
mike_oncall: Blocked key. Monitor.
(sre_bot): Incident updated: mitigation in progress, impact reduced. Next update in 20m or on change.
liz_support: Posted customer update.
mike_oncall: After swap + throttle + key block p95=0.9s p99=1.8s queue=1200. Closing on-call window; will keep monitoring for 2 hrs then hand back to regular oncall.
anna_platform: Creating follow-up ticket: AUTOSCALE-171048 — investigate quota-induced cascade and add alert for provisioner rate-limit anomalies.
kevin_infra: Filing cloud support ticket and asking for quota increase. ETA from cloud expedited team 18m.
mike_oncall: Thanks team. If anything spikes back — page me @mike_oncall. Otherwise I'll hand to rotation at 14:30 UTC.
sales_ops: Notifying the top 3 affected customers about mitigation and next steps.
liz_support: Drafting post-incident email for customers with timeline and mitigation steps.
(mike_oncall) : resolved? marking as partial-resolved in timeline until autoscaler fixes and quota confirmed.
incident_bot: Incident P0 update logged. Runbook steps executed: degraded routing, free-tier throttle, reserved-pool reassign, partner key block. Metrics: api_p95 0.9s, api_p99 1.8s, queue_depth 1200. Closing thread after handoff.
